title: becoming the world's most measured woman

segments.text: Kay Tolo is about to become the most measured female in history. That's an awkward wave. >> [laughter] >> She's going to spend the next several months doing exactly the same thing every day while we measure hundreds of biomarkers across every phase of her menstrual cycle. In summary, this experiment will cover 1,900 biomarkers, 16 biological systems, 14.8 million data points, over 50 different devices, and the annual cost 2.6 million dollars.
